FARM RATES
STANDARD RATE
This rate is for farms with normal household and agricultural use, served through SaskPower - supplied transformation up to and including 3000 kilovolt amperes (kVA).
Rate Code* E34
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic monthly charge $48.02
Demand Charge First 50 kVA/month $0
Balance $/kVA $15.727
Energy Charge First 16,000 kWh/month (¢/kWh) 13.852¢
Balance (¢/kWh) 5.820¢
MINIMUM BILL The basic monthly charge plus $5.059/kVA of the maximum demand over 50 kVA
registered in the defined billing periods between May 1st to October 31st and
November 1st to April 30th. The month containing the highest registered demand
within a defined billing period will be used to calculate the minimum bill for the
remainder of that period. LOADS ABOVE 3,000 KVA
For loads in excess of 3,000 kVA, a different rate structure will apply. Please see
Customer-Owned Transformation - Power Standard Rates.

FARM RATES
IRRIGATION RATE
This rate is for farm irrigation loads served through SaskPower-supplied transformation for the annual pumping season between February 1 and Oct. 31.
Rate Code* E19
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic seasonal charge $659.83
Energy charge (¢/kWh) 9.724¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic seasonal charge. LOADS ABOVE 3,000 KVA
For loads in excess of 3,000 kVA, a different rate structure will apply. Please see
Customer-Owned Transformation - Power Standard Rates.

FARM RATES
IRRIGATION (INTERRUPTIBLE) RATE This rate is for farm irrigation main pumping stations requiring in excess of 1,000 kilovolt
amperes (kVA) served on an interruptible basis through customer-owned transformation, and for related booster pumps and pivot systems less than 1,000 kVA
that will be inoperable as a consequence of an interruption to the main pumping station. The annual irrigation pumping season is from February 1 to Oct. 31.
Rate Code* E41
Effective February 1, 2026 (Over 1,000 kVA)
Basic charge per meter location (February to $1,244.10/month
October) Energy charge (¢/kWh) 8.331¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic charge.
AVAILABILITY Irrigation (Interruptible) rates are closed to new customers, effective July 1, 1997.
